name: PREP: point, reason, example, point
blurb: The quickest structure for any impromptu topic.

sections.label: Point
sections.prompt: Say your main idea in one sentence.

sections.label: Reason
sections.prompt: Why do you think that? Give one clear reason.

sections.label: Example
sections.prompt: A story, an experience or a real case that shows it.

sections.label: Point again
sections.prompt: Come back to your point, in new words, and finish.

name: Past, present, future
blurb: Good for topics about change, places, objects and ideas.

sections.label: Past
sections.prompt: How was it before? A memory or a piece of history.

sections.label: Present
sections.prompt: How is it now? What has changed?

sections.label: Future
sections.prompt: Where is it going, or where should it go? End here.

name: Problem, cause, solution
blurb: Good for scenarios and anything you would change or fix.

sections.label: Problem
sections.prompt: What's wrong? Make the audience feel it.

sections.label: Cause
sections.prompt: Why does it happen?

sections.label: Solution
sections.prompt: What should we do, and why will it work?

name: Three angles: me, us, the world
blurb: Good for single words and objects: zoom out in three steps.

sections.label: Me
sections.prompt: What does it mean to you? A personal moment.

sections.label: Us
sections.prompt: What does it mean for your school, family or community?

sections.label: The world
sections.prompt: What does it mean for everyone? Finish with a big idea.

name: Persuasive speech
blurb: Convince your audience to believe or do something.

sections.label: Hook
sections.prompt: Grab attention: a question, a surprising fact you can source, or a short story.

sections.label: Your position
sections.prompt: Say exactly what you want the audience to believe, in one sentence.

sections.label: First reason
sections.prompt: Your strongest reason, with an example or evidence.

sections.label: Second reason
sections.prompt: Another reason, with an example or evidence.

sections.label: Third reason
sections.prompt: A third reason, or a deeper look at why it matters.

sections.label: The other side
sections.prompt: The best argument against you, and your answer to it.

sections.label: Call to action
sections.prompt: What should the audience do now? End strongly.

name: Informative speech
blurb: Teach your audience about something you know well.

sections.label: Hook
sections.prompt: Why should they care? Start with something they'll remember.

sections.label: Preview
sections.prompt: Tell them the two or three things they'll learn.

sections.label: First idea
sections.prompt: Explain it simply, with an example.

sections.label: Second idea
sections.prompt: Build on the first, with an example.

sections.label: Third idea
sections.prompt: The most interesting part, saved for last.

sections.label: Summary
sections.prompt: Remind them of the main ideas in a sentence or two.

sections.label: Close
sections.prompt: Leave them with a thought or a question.

name: Personal story
blurb: Tell a true story from your life that teaches something.

sections.label: Opening moment
sections.prompt: Start in the middle of the action: where were you, what was happening?

sections.label: The situation
sections.prompt: Give just enough background for the audience to follow.

sections.label: The challenge
sections.prompt: What went wrong, or what was hard?

sections.label: The turning point
sections.prompt: What changed? What did you decide or realise?

sections.label: The lesson
sections.prompt: What did you learn, and why does it matter to the audience?

sections.label: Close
sections.prompt: Link back to your opening moment.

name: Tribute or thank-you speech
blurb: Honour a person, a group or an occasion.

sections.label: Welcome
sections.prompt: Who are you, and why are you speaking today?

sections.label: Who we honour
sections.prompt: Introduce the person or group.

sections.label: What makes them special
sections.prompt: Two or three qualities, each with a short story or example.

sections.label: Their impact
sections.prompt: What difference have they made to others?

sections.label: Thanks and close
sections.prompt: Say thank you directly, and finish with a warm line.
